causes.problem_statement: getDaemonAddress and getPidFilePath used path.resolve(root) without resolving symlinks via fs.realpathSync.native, diverging from resolveRoot(args) which resolves repoRoot canonical realpaths.
causes.type_effect: On macOS runners (/var -> /private/var) and Windows runners (8.3 short paths RUNNER~1), daemon socket/pipe hash differed between daemon server and client, causing IPC connection failure in CI subtest 50.
causes.type_solution: Standardized canonical path resolution using fs.realpathSync.native in getDaemonAddress, getPidFilePath, registerDaemon, and WaymarkDaemon constructor.

causes.problem_statement: normalizeRelativePath evaluated path.resolve(input) instead of path.resolve(slashPath). On POSIX systems, backslash is a valid filename character, not a directory separator.
causes.type_effect: Intra-repo paths containing Windows-style backslashes were treated by path.relative() on Linux/macOS as '../repo\\sample.ts', triggering an erroneous INVALID_PATH escape exception in subtest 60.
causes.type_solution: Updated normalizeRelativePath to resolve normInput from slashPath (input.replaceAll('\\', '/')) before containment check.

causes.problem_statement: v2.3.0 release notes and CHANGELOG referenced benchmark harnesses under scratch/benchmarks/, but scratch/ was included in .gitignore.
causes.type_effect: External evaluators and users cloning the repository encountered missing file errors when attempting to reproduce benchmark claims.
causes.type_solution: Promoted scratch/benchmarks/ to tracked root benchmarks/ directory and updated all documentation references.

causes.problem_statement: In prompt generator draft for test 10-07, expected_range was set to non-existent lines rather than capturing historical agent range [5, 7] against live on-disk span [10, 12].
causes.type_effect: Drift evaluator evaluated target range [20, 22] rather than verifying that historical pin [5, 7] relocated to [10, 12] with an identical AST content hash, returning STALE_OR_MODIFIED instead of VERIFIED_DRIFTED.
causes.type_solution: Defined historical expected_range [5, 7] and live on-disk range [10, 12] sharing SHA-256 span hash f4034733cc736b8659af8336ca24c117df0f75705774df730c356593c0a449e7, computing Delta_lines = +5 offset and reporting VERIFIED_DRIFTED.
